question: ৩৪. কেটলিতে পানি টগ্বগ্ করছে।[cite: 1]

question: ৩৯. I wish I had seen you before. (Exclamatory)[cite: 1]

ঘ. If I seen you before.

question: ৪০. Besides going to the book fair, I bought a number of books. (Compound)[cite: 1]

answers.text: ক. I not only went to the book fair but also bought a number of books.
খ. I went to the book fair and bought a number of books.
গ. Going to the book fair, I bought a number of books.
ঘ. I bought a number of books when I went to the book fair.

correct_answer: খ. I went to the book fair and bought a number of books.
hint: Besides + V-ing যুক্ত Simple বাক্যকে 'and' দ্বারা যুক্ত করে Compound করা হয়।

question: ৪১. Do you find your payment too little? (Passive)[cite: 1]

answers.text: ক. Is your payment found too little to you?
খ. Are your payment found too little to you?
গ. Are your payment found too little by you?
ঘ. Is your payment found too little by you?

correct_answer: ঘ. Is your payment found too little by you?
hint: Present Indefinite-এর Interrogative Passive করতে: Auxiliary verb (Is) + Subject (your payment) + V3 (found) + remaining + by + object (you)।

question: ৪২. There is little milk in the glass. (Interrogative)[cite: 1]

correct_answer: গ. Is there any milk in the glass?

question: ৪৩. I know him better than you. (Positive)[cite: 1]
